verdict.rationale: Square documents a Payouts API, which is the right surface for tracking bank deposits. It also has separate Refunds and Disputes APIs and an application-fees feature, and its marketing says one sales report reduces reconciliation time. However, the Payouts API appears only as a title, and nothing shows payouts broken into fee, refund and chargeback line items matched to bank deposits. Missing for 10: documented payout-to-bank-deposit reconciliation, itemized payout entry breakdowns of fees/refunds/chargebacks, settlement report details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
